# Ask Your Markdown

Ask Your Markdown answers questions over a folder of Markdown files using Google's Open Knowledge Format (OKF).

Instead of requiring chunking, embeddings, and a vector database, it lets an LLM navigate folder indexes, metadata, links, documents, and sections. It also supports deterministic offline keyword search without an LLM.

## Capabilities

- AI-guided OKF browsing
- Offline deterministic keyword search
- Folder indexes and metadata-based navigation
- Source-grounded answers showing which pages were used
- OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry support
- Fully offline operation when using keyword retrieval
